# Platform Sutra

*[Huineng](../philosophers/huineng.md) · *Liuzu tanjing**

A Chan text recording the life and teaching of [Huineng](../philosophers/huineng.md), the sixth patriarch: Buddha nature is present in everyone and awakening is sudden. Compiled by his disciples, it was reworked over several centuries.
